set.body: Acceptance: EventDetector exposes a versioned AlgorithmCard for canonical I-VT, canonical I-DT, and Engbert-Kliegl; each card records citation, assumptions, exact deviations, coordinate/sampling requirements, streaming status, designated reference implementation and pinned reference version; every named detector has a card and no paper-named detector can run without one.
set.title: Publish detector algorithm cards and reference identities
